The Addl. Director (Admn.), Medical and Health Services,
 State of Rajasthan, Jaipur.
----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Dr. Sachin Achary  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE P.K. LOHRA Order 12/07/2018

It is submitted by learned counsel that impugned order dated 19.06.2018 (Annex.5) is passed by third respondent who is not empowered to pass an order of suspension as the appointing authority of petitioner is Commissioner of Food Safely.

In support of his contention,
learned counsel has relied on Section 30 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short, 'the Act').

Emphasis is laid on sub-section (3) of Section 30 of the Act, whereunder for limited purposes Commissioner of Food Safety can delegate his powers to any subordinate authority but such delegation is not permissible vis-a-vis Food Safety Officers.
In the meanwhile, effect and operation of impugned order dated 19.06.2018 (Annex.5) shall remain stayed.
